name: neumorph-button
blurb: Soft, embossed button with subtle shadows.
description: A button styled with soft inset and outset shadows creating a neumorphic (soft UI) effect. No color contrast; uses light/dark offsets.
use_when: You want a soft, modern aesthetic without bold colors.
avoid_when: When clear visual contrast is needed; neumorphic buttons can have poor accessibility.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Shadow-based visual hierarchy; no color contrast. May fail WCAG color contrast requirements.
